result:
I’d remove the lottery of circumstance—so that where you’re born, how much money your family has, or whether you know where to ask for help doesn’t determine your access to food, safety, healthcare, education, and human support.

People would still face hardship and disagreement, but far fewer would spend their whole potential merely surviving—or have to face their hardest moments completely alone.

Not necessary unless personal experience. Perhaps "I’d give every person a fair chance to flourish..." Generic. Better one specific change with clarity.

I wouldn’t want a world without difficulty; I’d want one where difficulty reliably brings help rather than isolation."
